title: Tensor coherence of the canonical pullback-square comparison
statement: Let f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y be arbitrary scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], with fibre-product projections f′:X′→Y′ and gX:X′→X [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback] and the fixed canonical composition isomorphisms c [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Define α: Lg*⋙Lf′* ≅ Lf*⋙LgX* by c(f′,g), equality transport along the square condition, and c(gX,f) inverse. For all P,Q in the derived category of OY-modules [def-pc-derived-category], the normalized pullback tensor comparisons τ [lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso] satisfy Lf′*(τg(P,Q));τf′(Lg*P,Lg*Q);(αP⊗αQ) = α(P⊗Q);LgX*(τf(P,Q));τgX(Lf*P,Lf*Q). No right adjoint, direct-image pairing, or base-change map occurs in this equality.

proof.text: Prove that compatibility on K-flat representatives: the termwise pullback-composition comparison is the mate of the ordinary direct-image composition comparison, and the ordinary pullback tensor comparison sends pulled-back pure tensors to the tensor of their pulled-back sections. Both composition paths give those same sections. The normalization equations of the tensorators and composition comparisons transport this equation through their invertible derived counits. K-flat resolutions and naturality extend it to every A,B.

theorem mixedPullbackSquareComparison_tensor
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) :
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd f g)).map
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso g).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      (mixedHomTensorPullbackIso (pullback.snd f g)).hom.app
        ((derivedPullback g).obj P, (derivedPullback g).obj Q) ≫
      ((mixedPullbackSquareComparison f g).hom.app P ⊗ₘ
        (mixedPullbackSquareComparison f g).hom.app Q) =
    (mixedPullbackSquareComparison f g).hom.app (P ⊗ Q) ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).map
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso f).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      (mixedHomTensorPullbackIso (pullback.fst f g)).hom.app
        ((derivedPullback f).obj P, (derivedPullback f).obj Q)
